phrases.english: Quiet dove grey, soft wings unfurl.
phrases.serbian: Tiho golubije siva, meka krila se razvijaju.
phrases.transliteration: Tiho golubije siva, meka krila se razvijaju.

phrases.english: Spicy paprika red, a warm embrace.
Rich dark chocolate, a sweet delight.
Smart money moves, pave the way.
Build your fortune, brick by brick.
phrases.serbian: Gradite svoje bogatstvo, ciglu po ciglu.
phrases.transliteration: Gra-di-te svo-ye bo-gat-stvo, tsig-lu po tsig-lu.

phrases.english: A small frog, croaks by the pond.
The proud rooster, crows at dawn.
A sleepy kitten, dreams of milk.
The gentle lamb, skips in the meadow.
A busy ant, carries a crumb.

phrases.transliteration: Ti si, moja nay sla-dja mi-saw.

phrases.english: Feeling a bit dreamy, you see?
A pang of longing, for home.
